README learning-curve table and note still say month 01 133/133 (100.0%) with 42.1% no suggestion; the cited benchmark prints 167/177 (94.4%) and 24.3%. Persists from 2026-11-07.

The page's 'Not modelled' paragraph lists accruals, depreciation, inventory, sales tax, splitting a line and locking a period, all of which the same page or engine now offers (depreciation and MACRS sections, sales tax return worksheet, inventory register, split entry, lockPeriod). A reader is told the tool cannot do what it does; the paragraph is stale.

Form 8959 Additional Medicare tax multiplies cents by a float rate and rounds: 0.009 x 3,087,500 = 27787.4999 gives 277.87, not 277.88 (half-up). Same pattern on SE lines; integer arithmetic (e.g. Math.round(x * 9 / 1000)) avoids it.
A file whose dates are all ambiguous (no part above 12) is read month-first with no problems entry, so a D/M/Y bank file lands in the wrong months silently. Persists from 2026-11-07.
The estimated-payment plan without --as-of marks all four installments 'due' with equal amounts even in November; the CLI does not default asOf to today. Persists from 2026-11-07.

Grocery chains (whole foods, trader joe, safeway, instacart) are suggested to Meals 6130 with no personal-spend caution; now held in review at 0.7 rather than auto-posted (partly improved since 2026-11-09).
37 probe*/gaps* test files, 38 eval/probe*.mjs scripts and a committed binary ledger-1.0.1-py3-none-any.whl remain; receipts.mjs 1,653 and bank.mjs 1,449 lines. Persists.

verdict: Re-check of the six 2026-11-09 defects against main at 922662cc7 (130 venture commits since, mostly receipt OCR): two closed (the 5-day transfer boundary is now caught by pair-transfers-window.test.mjs from PR #17505; the retired host is gone from llms.txt, index.html and sitemap), one partly improved (grocery lines held in review, not auto-posted), three persist (unpinned $400 SE threshold, stale README month-01 row, probe/whl clutter), and two older lows persist (silent month-first dates, as-of-less payment plan). On new inputs the tax worksheets were right: Schedule SE at 200,000 (28,234.30), 2026 and 2025 brackets, MACRS Tables A-1/A-2/A-5, three EIC table cells, a full 2026 estimate at 250,000 (66,360.02, one cent off on Form 8959 from float rounding), and a three-account month tied to 1,596.56 and balanced. 2857 tests pass; 3 of 4 seeded bugs were caught, the $400 threshold again was not. New claims defect: the page's 'Not modelled' paragraph denies six features the page offers. Correctness 3, verification 3, claims 2: finished, still below the bar on claims.
